5254-5686-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5686-6627.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-5687--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-3240-6462-7396.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-3446-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

1429-2511-3545.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

654-4094-4772-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-4094-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

654-880-7893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped
When the land enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Thranduil trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land that entered.
Resolve the Thranduil trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3617-7757-7758-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3617-7757-7758-7843.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Elrond.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Time Walk.
Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

475-1274-1379-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-1379-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-4866-7426-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1912-4866-7426-7737.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5434-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7640.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2724-3217-7309.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Don & Leo. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

772-891-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

147-3497-7300.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
147-3497-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-4927-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-4927-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

628-5686-7197.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

628-5147-7199.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4659-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
1270-4659-5320.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create three creature tokens due to Ojer Taq
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
1270-4659-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

2557-4017-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4017-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

342-3537-5776.description:
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {0} due to Sam's reduction effect, as Bog Initiate is a Food due to Ygra, adding {B}.
Repeat.

147-413-554.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-554.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Extract from Darkness.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

628-4050-6935.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2173-3239-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1365-1651-2438-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2438-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

4215-5220-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
4215-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3532-4985-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-4985-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

338-3197-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-4268.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2556-5733-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2556-5733-6122.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2167-2907-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-2907-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

254-2440-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
254-2440-3490.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and First Day of Class trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the First Day of Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

687-2511-3220-5004.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three counters among creatures you control.
687-2511-3220-5004.description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Golgari Germination trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token that enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 1, causing you to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyyrson Starn.

428-3090-3908-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-3090-3908-5096.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

2573-3946-5447.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control without summoning sickness

2155-3259-4478.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1870-4241-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4241-4873-5087.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Eternity Vessel and Darksteel Reactor to become artifact creatures until end of turn.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

2232-2604-3446.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with morph or megamorph.
You have a creature card with morph or megamorph in your hand.
2232-2604-3446.description:
Cast the creature card with morph or megamorph from your hand for its morph cost by paying {0}.
Whenever the face-down creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another creature with morph or megamorph to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
